title: What was the first thing you ever resold?
body: How did it start for you? The first thing you bought to sell on, what you paid, what it went for, and whether you would buy it again today.

title: Which platform surprised you most this year?
body: Something sold faster, slower or for more than you expected somewhere. Which platform, and what do you think made the difference?

title: Car boot or charity shop: where do you find more?
body: If you could only source from one for a month, which would it be and why? Say which part of the country you are in, as it changes everything.

title: What is the one tool you would not sell without?
body: An app, a spreadsheet, a label printer, a tape gun. What saves you the most time, and what did you use before it?

title: How do you decide when to drop a price?
body: Days listed, watchers, views, gut feeling? Share the rule you actually follow, even if it is a loose one.

title: What does your packing area look like?
body: Kitchen table, spare room, garage, unit? A photo if you are happy to share. What would you change about it?

title: What is the item you always pass on now?
body: Something that looks like a good buy but has burned you before. Returns, slow sales, fees, fakes. What is it and what happened?

title: How many hours a week do you put in?
body: Sourcing, listing, packing, messages. Roughly how does your week split, and is it a side hustle or the main job?

title: What question do new sellers ask you most?
body: If you have been at it a while, what do friends and family always ask when they find out you resell? What do you tell them?

title: Returns: what is your honest return rate?
body: Roughly what share of your sales come back, on which platform, and what is the most common reason? It helps everyone set expectations.

title: What sells for you that nobody expects?
body: The category or item that people laugh at until they see the sold price. No need to give away your best spot.

title: Do you list on more than one platform at once?
body: If you cross-list, how do you stop selling the same item twice? If you do not, what keeps you on one?

title: What does a good sourcing day look like for you?
body: How much you spend, how many items you come home with, and what makes it worth the petrol.

title: How do you photograph your stock?
body: Phone or camera, daylight or lights, background, mannequin or flat lay. What made the biggest difference to your sales?

title: Have you had a buyer scam attempt recently?
body: What did the message say and how did you spot it? Leave out names and usernames, and share it so others can spot the next one.

title: What would you tell yourself on day one?
body: One thing you wish you had known when you started reselling. The mistake that cost the most, or the habit that paid off.

title: How do you keep track of your numbers?
body: Spreadsheet, app, shoebox of receipts? What do you record for each item, and how long does it take you each week?

title: What is your slowest-selling category?
body: The stock that sits there longest. Do you keep buying it anyway, and if so, why is it worth it?

title: Postage: which service do you use most?
body: Royal Mail, Evri, InPost, a courier through the platform? What decides it for you: price, tracking, drop-off, or claims?

title: Live selling: have you tried it yet?
body: Whatnot, eBay Live, TikTok. If you have done a show, how did the first one go? If you have not, what is stopping you?

title: What is your best find for under a pound?
body: The one you still talk about. What was it, where did you find it, and what did it go for?

title: How do you handle offers and haggling?
body: Do you price high and expect offers, or price to sell? What do you do with a cheeky first offer?

title: What made you start taking reselling seriously?
body: Was there a moment, a sale or a month where it stopped being a hobby? What changed after that?

title: Which fee change hit you hardest?
body: Postage rises, final value fees, per-order fees, storage. Which one changed how you work, and what did you do about it?
